name: @pipeworx/mcp-kr-equities

tools.name: kr_search_stocks
tools.description: Resolve a Korean company name (Korean or English) or 6-character stock code to its listed issuer, code and market (KOSPI or KOSDAQ). Use this to map a ticker like 005930 to Samsung Electronics (삼성전자) or to find the code for "SK hynix". Includes ETFs, flagged via is_etf.

query.description: Company name (삼성전자, "samsung electronics", hynix) or stock code (005930)

tools.name: kr_quote
tools.description: Current or last-close quote for one Korean listed stock by 6-character code: price, change, day range, volume, market cap, 52-week range, PER/PBR/EPS/dividend yield, foreign ownership, and the issuer identity and exchange (KOSPI/KOSDAQ). Returns market_status (OPEN/CLOSE) and the exchange timestamp.

code.description: 6-character Korean stock code, e.g. 005930 (Samsung Electronics), 000660 (SK hynix)

tools.name: kr_price_history
tools.description: Daily OHLCV history for one Korean listed stock, newest first, with the performance over the window (first-to-last close change %). Use for "how has X performed" questions.

tools.name: kr_investor_flows
tools.description: Recent daily net buying by investor type (foreign, institutional, individual) in shares for one Korean listed stock, plus the foreign holding ratio, newest first.

tools.name: kr_index
tools.description: Level, change and recent daily history of a Korean market index: KOSPI, KOSDAQ or KOSPI200.

days.description: Daily history rows to include (default 5, max 60)

tools.name: kr_top_by_market_cap
tools.description: The largest listed companies on KOSPI or KOSDAQ ranked by market capitalisation, with code, price, daily change and volume. Includes ranking offset for paging.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-kr-equities forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the kr-equities pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
